landing.metaTitle: Miaurmario — your wardrobe on your phone
landing.metaDescription: Photograph your clothes and Stinky, a cat with taste, tells you what to wear. Nothing to download: it opens in your browser. Free while in beta.
landing.ogImageAlt: Miaurmario: your wardrobe on your phone, with Stinky the cat.

hero.pitch: Your wardrobe on your phone: photograph your clothes and Stinky tells you what to wear
hero.sub: Nothing to download and no app store: it opens in your phone's browser, like any other website.
hero.betaInviteOnly: We're in beta and opening up slowly: leave your email and we'll write to you as soon as there's room for you.
hero.betaOpen: We're in beta: it's free and you can create your account right now.

features.title: Your clothes, sorted — and someone to advise you

wardrobe.title: Your wardrobe, one photo at a time
wardrobe.body: Photograph each garment and Stinky files it away tagged: type, colour, season. Search for "black shirts" and there they are, without digging through the real wardrobe.
wardrobe.alt: The wardrobe inside Miaurmario: a grid of photographed garments with filters by clothing type.

today.title: Today's look, moment by moment
today.body: Morning, afternoon and evening: Stinky suggests a look for each moment of the day using what you already own, checking the weather and what you wore this week.
today.alt: Miaurmario's "today's look" screen, with the moments of the day and the garments in the suggested outfit.

chat.title: Just ask Stinky
chat.body: "What do I wear to dinner on Friday?" Tell him in the chat and he puts the look together from your clothes, not from a catalogue.
chat.alt: The chat with Stinky inside Miaurmario, with a question about what to wear and his answer.

friends.title: And let your friends weigh in
friends.body: Share looks with whoever you choose and ask for a second opinion before going out. What you don't share, nobody sees.
friends.alt: The friends feed in Miaurmario, with shared looks and reactions.

install.title: Is it an app? Where do I download it?
install.lead: Nowhere: there is nothing to download and no App Store or Google Play involved. Miaurmario is a website. Open the link in your phone's browser and you're in.
install.lead2: If you want it one tap away, like any other app, you can add it to your home screen in two steps. It opens full screen, with its own icon, takes up almost nothing and updates itself.
install.iosStep2: Tap Share and choose Add to Home Screen.
install.androidStep2: Tap the ⋮ menu and choose Install app.
install.note: On a computer it works the same in any modern browser, with nothing to install.

trust.title: The important bits, plainly
trust.priceBody: No card asked for and no ads.
trust.photosTitle: The photos of your clothes are yours
trust.photosBody: They stay in your account. We don't sell them, nobody you haven't shown them to sees them, and we don't train models on them. You can delete a garment, or the whole account, whenever you want.
trust.whoBody: A personal project by Andrei Pop, with the data on his own server in the European Union.

footer.detail: Privacy and terms has the detail: what is stored, who it's shared with to tag your garments and how to ask us to delete it.

guide.title: Getting Last.fm, in 3 steps
guide.intro: Last.fm is a notebook that writes down everything you listen to. We only read that notebook: it never touches your music and never needs your password.
guide.step1Body: It's free and only asks for an email and a username. Remember that username: it's the only thing you'll give us.
guide.step2Title: Connect Spotify or Apple Music inside Last.fm
guide.step2Body: In your Last.fm settings, under “Applications”, connect the service you listen on. From then on Last.fm writes down every song you play: that is “scrobbling”, and it's what gives us something to read. Without this step your profile stays empty.
guide.step3Body: Type your Last.fm username in the field above and that's it. Your plays show up in Miaurmario within minutes.
guide.publicTitle: Your listening has to be public
guide.publicBody: We can only read a profile that shows its recent listening. On Last.fm: Settings → Privacy → leave “Hide my recent listening” unchecked.

legal.metaDescription: What data Miaurmario keeps, why, and how to delete it.
legal.title: Privacy and terms

who.title: Who is behind it
who.p1: Miaurmario is a personal project by Andrei Pop. For anything related to your data, write to {contact}.

data.title: What data we keep
data.p1: Your email (to sign in with a magic link), your username and, if you add them, your display name, bio, approximate location and style preferences.
data.p2: Photos of your clothes, their tags, and the outfits, ratings and history you create in the app.
data.p3: If you connect Spotify: what you're listening to, your recent plays and your top artists, only to infer the "mood" used to suggest looks. We don't store your full history.
data.p4: If you connect Pinterest: the boards and pins you choose to import, read-only. We never post anything to your account.
data.p5: Spotify and Pinterest access tokens are stored encrypted, and you can revoke them by disconnecting the integration in Settings.

purpose.title: What we use it for
purpose.p1: Only to make the app work: showing your wardrobe, suggesting outfits, your local weather and the notifications you turn on.
purpose.p2: We don't sell or hand over your data, we don't show ads and we don't use it to train models.

sharing.title: Who it's shared with
sharing.p1: AI provider (OpenAI-compatible API): receives the clothing photos and descriptions needed to tag them and suggest looks.
sharing.p2: Resend: sends the sign-in emails. Cloudflare: protects and serves the website. Open-Meteo: weather data for your approximate location.
sharing.p3: Spotify and Pinterest: only if you connect your account, and only to read the data described above.

retention.title: Where and for how long
retention.p1: Data is stored on our own server in the European Union for as long as you have an account. If you delete your account or ask us to, we delete your data and photos within 30 days.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.p1: You can request access to, correction, export or deletion of your data, or object to its processing, by writing to {contact}. You can also file a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (aepd.es).

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.p1: Miaurmario is provided as is, without warranties, and may change or stop being available. Only upload photos you have the right to use, and don't use the app for anything illegal or that bothers other people.

how.title: How this works
how.body: Stinky writes these notes himself while you chat, so he doesn't ask you the same thing every week.
how.point1: He only notes things that help him dress you: styles, colours, how you like clothes to sit, recurring plans, sizes or materials.
how.point2: He never notes anything about your health, your body, your weight, your religion, your sexuality, your politics or your money. If he tries, we block it.

unsubscribe.pushNote: This only affects email: notifications on your devices stay as they are.

upload.title: Add your clothes
upload.body: One photo per item: the background is removed automatically and AI tags it. No AI on your plan? Tag it yourself in a moment.

day.title: Your day
day.body: I look out of the window and suggest looks for the weather and your plans, for several moments of the day: office, gym, dinner…

stylist.title: Stylist and chat
stylist.body: Ask me for a look for an occasion (a wedding, an interview) or just talk to me: I have your wardrobe in front of me, and plenty of opinions.

inspo.title: Inspiration
inspo.body: Follow your friends (by @handle only), connect your music from Spotify or Last.fm and bring in your Pinterest boards.

install.title: Install and turn on alerts
install.body: Put me on your home screen and I'll send you the look of the day without you opening anything. I always find a spot.

install.pushOn: Alerts are on for this device
install.pushBlocked: Alerts are blocked: you can allow them in your browser settings.
install.iosNeedsInstall: On iPhone, install it first: alerts arrive when you open it from the home screen.
install.deniedToast: Without permission I can't alert you. You can change it any time.
install.errorToast: Couldn't turn on alerts. Try Settings → Notifications.

tips.wardrobe: this is where your clothes live. Tap an item to edit it, or check your looks and history in the tabs. I'm keeping watch from the top of the wardrobe.
tips.stylist: tell me the occasion and the plan, and I'll build a look from what you own. Prrr.
tips.inspo: find your friends by their @handle and connect Spotify, Last.fm or Pinterest to fine-tune your style.
tips.stinky: ask me anything: what to wear today, what goes with what, or what you're missing. I'm awake — make the most of it.
tips.settings: your city, alert times, integrations and family. I take whatever you change here into account.

firstSteps.emptyBody: Pick several photos at once: I take the background off and tag them (or you do, in two taps, if your plan has no AI).
firstSteps.progress: {count} of {min} items before Stinky starts suggesting looks
firstSteps.progressHint: Ideally a top and a bottom, or a dress and some shoes.
firstSteps.untagged: You have {untyped, plural, one {# untagged photo} other {# untagged photos}}. Until I know what they are, the wardrobe still looks empty to me.
firstSteps.untaggedHint: Type and colour, one tap each. With {min} tagged items I can already suggest something.
firstSteps.variety: With {target} items I start suggesting real looks; you have {count}.
firstSteps.varietyHint: I can manage with {min}, but I repeat myself a lot. The more there are, the less I do.

styleQuiz.pageDescription: What you have told Stinky about your taste. It is about clothes, not about you.
styleQuiz.saveError: I couldn't save your style. Try again.
styleQuiz.savedToast: Saved. I'll keep it in mind.
styleQuiz.emptyState: I don't know what you like yet. Take a quick quiz and I'll start suggesting looks with your taste, not mine.
styleQuiz.lastTuned: Last time you tuned your style: {date}
styleQuiz.deckHint: Swipe the card or use the buttons. The ← and → keys work too.
styleQuiz.deckIntro: ✕ not for me · ♥ I like it · “Not fussed” leaves the card as it was.
styleQuiz.skipCardLabel: Not fussed: changes nothing, move to the next card
styleQuiz.chipsFull: That's plenty, I can work with those

steps.fit: How you like it to sit

length.title: Quick or thorough?
length.body: Your call. You can redo it or go further whenever you like.
length.bodyMerge: Whatever you pick now wins; anything you don't touch stays as it is.

quick.title: Quick
quick.body: {cards} cards and a couple of questions. Under a minute.

deep.title: Thorough
deep.body: {cards} cards and all the questions. About three minutes.

fit.title: How do you like clothes to sit?
fit.body: This is about the garment, not about you: it helps me pick the cut.

garment.title: What kind of clothes should I suggest?
garment.body: It's the shop section I look in, not a question about you.
garment.note: Optional. Leave it and I'll suggest anything.

sizes.title: Your usual sizes
sizes.body: Optional, and every shop is different: put down whatever you normally order. I use it to tell you which size to look at if I suggest something you don't own.
sizes.atShopHint: A reminder so you can pick in the shop yourself. I don't buy anything.
sizes.none: You haven't told me your sizes yet.
sizes.saveError: I couldn't save your sizes. Try again.

brands.title: Brands, designers or references
brands.body: Whatever inspires you. I use them as a compass, not to copy them.

occasions.title: What do you dress for most?
occasions.body: Office, uni, going out, home… whatever fills your week.

neverWear.title: Things you never wear
neverWear.body: Garments, cuts or prints you don't want to see in my suggestions.

colorsAvoid.title: Colours you'd rather avoid
colorsAvoid.body: I'll leave them out unless there's no other option.

summary.title: What Stinky has learned
summary.empty: You haven't told me anything yet. No problem: I'll learn from what you wear.
summary.editable: You can edit it or redo it whenever you like from Settings → Your style.
summary.changed: You changed your mind on {count, plural, one {one thing} other {# things}}: {list}.

restyle.title: Tune your style again
restyle.body: Three ways to do it, whichever suits you.

adjust.title: Adjust what I have
adjust.body: Change only what you want, no need to redo the quiz.

merge.title: Merge with the old one
merge.body: Swipe again; the new answers win and the rest stays.

fresh.title: Start from scratch
fresh.body: I delete your profile and ask everything again.
fresh.confirmBody: Everything you told me about your style is deleted and I ask it all again. This can't be undone.

editor.title: Adjust what I have
editor.body: Tap a card to change it: like → not for me → no opinion.

minimal.title: Clean minimalism
minimal.body: Few pieces, straight lines, zero noise.
minimal.examples: White tee + straight trousers + plain trainer.

streetwear.title: Streetwear
streetwear.body: Hoodies, trainers and logos with attitude.

tailored.title: Tailoring
tailored.examples: Blazer + pleated trousers + leather ankle boot.

boho.title: Bohemian
boho.body: Flowing fabrics, prints, a festival air.
boho.examples: Long printed dress + cloth bag + ankle boot.

preppy.title: Preppy
preppy.body: Polos, knitwear over the shoulders, boat shoes.
preppy.examples: Knitted jumper + checked skirt + white trainer.

vintage.title: Vintage and second-hand
vintage.body: Pieces with a history, nothing straight off the rail.
vintage.examples: Striped shirt + straight jeans + second-hand bag.

romantic.title: Romantic and flowing
romantic.examples: Floaty dress + small bag + low ankle boot.

oversize.title: Loose volumes
oversize.body: Everything a couple of sizes up, on purpose.
oversize.examples: Tee two sizes up + wide trousers, never your exact size.

fitted.title: Close lines
fitted.body: Garments that follow the line, no slack.
fitted.examples: Close-knit jumper + skinny trousers + narrow ankle boot.

wide-leg.title: Wide-leg trousers
wide-leg.body: A broad leg falling straight to the floor.
wide-leg.examples: Palazzo trousers or wide jeans, straight from the hip.

layers.title: Long layers
layers.body: Coats and gilets stacked, cold or not.
layers.examples: Tee + blazer + long coat over the top.

monochrome.title: One single colour
monochrome.body: The same tone from top to bottom.
monochrome.examples: Grey on top, grey below, grey on the shoe.

neutrals.title: Warm neutrals
neutrals.examples: Ecru tee + camel trousers + beige trainer.

black-white.title: Black and white
black-white.examples: White tee + black trousers + grey trainer.

pastels.title: Pastels
pastels.examples: Baby-blue tee + pale-pink trousers + mint trainer.

brights.title: Bright colours
brights.examples: Yellow tee + electric-blue trousers + red trainer.

jewel.title: Deep tones
jewel.examples: Burgundy tee + navy trousers + bottle-green trainer.

selfie.title: What am I wearing
selfie.subtitle: Take a full-body photo and I'll tell you which of your garments you have on.

privacy.title: What happens to your photo
privacy.body: The photo is only read to recognise the clothes and is dropped as soon as that is done: it is not stored here or on the server. Camera data (date and location) is stripped, and only the garments are described, never the person.

selfie.tooLarge: That photo is too big (max {max} MB).
selfie.notAnImage: That is not a photo. Try an image.
selfie.analyzeFailed: I couldn't read the photo. Please try again.

nothingFound.title: I couldn't see any clothes
nothingFound.description: Try a full-body photo, with good light and the clothes in view.

selfie.notInWardrobe: This one isn't in your wardrobe
selfie.otherOptions: Not that one? Pick the garment
selfie.addFailed: The garment could not be added
selfie.addPhotoLater: Saved without a garment photo: yours is never cropped. You can add a photo whenever you like.
selfie.pickerDescription: Find the garment you're wearing in your wardrobe.
selfie.selectedCount: {count, plural, =0 {No garments picked} one {# garment in this look} other {# garments in this look}}
selfie.tooManySaves: That was quick. Wait a moment and try again.
selfie.needItems: Pick at least one garment from your wardrobe.

bulkUpload.title: Upload items
bulkUpload.subtitle: Several photos at once. You can close this: the upload carries on.
bulkUpload.reviewSubtitle: Confirm the type and the colour. Leave whatever is already right.
bulkUpload.reviewCta: Review {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}
bulkUpload.retryAll: Retry {count, plural, one {# failure} other {# failures}}
bulkUpload.resumed: Picking {count, plural, one {# photo} other {# photos}} back up from last time
bulkUpload.noAiNotice: Your plan does not tag with AI, so the items land untagged. When this finishes I ask you for the type and the colour of each one: two taps.

picker.headline: Drop your photos here
picker.hint: Up to {max} photos per batch, {size} MB each.
picker.room: Room for {room} more in this batch
picker.full: Batch full ({max}). Upload these and we carry on.
picker.skipAiHint: I just upload them and you tag them in the review.
picker.noAiHint: Your plan has no vision AI: items land untagged and you tag them at the end, type and colour, one tap each.

rejected.tooMany: Only {max} photos fit in a batch; I left the rest out.
rejected.tooBig: Some photo is over {size} MB, so I left it out.
rejected.wrongType: Some file was not an image, so I left it out.

errors.invalid_format: That is not a photo I can read
errors.rate_limited: Too many photos at once; wait a moment

review.needsWork: {count, plural, one {# still needs a type} other {# still need a type}}
review.allGood: All tagged. Have a look anyway.
review.hint: Tap an item to change its type or colour.
review.save: Save {count, plural, one {# change} other {# changes}}
review.saved: Saved. {count, plural, one {# item ready} other {# items ready}}.

stepper.whatIsIt: What kind of item is it?
